title: Thin bass everywhere

complaints.says: The bass sounds thin and weak today, even in the mains.

win.label: Full-sounding bass in the mains
win.hint: Turn Ch 8's HPF off (or to 80 Hz at most).

hints: The bass reaches everywhere, so nothing is unplugged. Something on the Bass channel is cutting its low end.
cause: The high-pass filter on the Bass channel was set to 250 Hz, cutting away most of the bass.
lesson: A high-pass filter cuts rumble below its frequency. Great on vocals around 100 Hz, but bass and kick drum need it off or very low.
